# Coding Uncertainty

This folder documents ambiguities and discrepancies in medical procedure registration within the Danish healthcare system. Specifically, it covers uncertainties surrounding the legitimate application of procedure codes, such as SKS-koden NAAZ42, when preoperative optimization is performed by an anesthesiologist outside of designated units like IMA or the ITA-afsnit. These coding ambiguities are significant because they can lead to inconsistent clinical data and billing discrepancies depending on the physical location where the optimization takes place.

## Pages

- [[coding-uncertainty|Coding Uncertainty]] — Details ambiguities in registering preoperative anesthesiological assessments, specifically whether procedure code NAAZ42 can be applied outside designated units like IMA or ITA-afsnit.
